stroma lamellae thylakoid membrane ribosome

thylakoid space starch grain DNA outer membrane

parts.text: identify the structures involved in the production of rubisco

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Paper chromatography is a technique that can be used to separate a mixture of four common chloroplast pigments. The pigments can be identified by calculating their $R_f$ values.

A student carried out paper chromatography on a solution containing a mixture of chloroplast pigments.

The results are shown in Table 7.1.

Table 7.1

| pigment | distance travelled by pigment from baseline/$\text{cm}$ | distance travelled by solvent from baseline/$\text{cm}$ | $R_f$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| .................... | 6.5 | 8.9 | 0.73 |
| chlorophyll a | 4.6 | 8.9 | 0.52 |
| chlorophyll b | .................... | 8.9 | 0.38 |
| carotene | 8.2 | 8.9 | .................... |

Complete Table 7.1.
